summary: IceCure Medical Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on April 21, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing its participation in the Society of Breast Imaging Symposium 2026 and reporting a preliminary 30%+ increase in U.S. ProSense revenue for Q1 2026 versus Q1 2025. The release describes commercial momentum following FDA clearance of ProSense for low-risk breast cancer. No transaction, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is involved. This is a routine operational update furnished by a foreign private issuer.
